title: Biorthogonal Conformal Dynamics in Non-Hermitian Quantum Quenches
summary: Global quenches at one-dimensional critical points admit a boundary conformal field theory (BCFT) description in which Euclidean strip correlators are analytically continued to real time. We formulate this construction for interacting non-Hermitian critical systems, where a right ket alone does not specify the dynamical readout and the left covector is part of the microscopic quench protocol.
